name: Sanemi Shinazugawa
classification: Human; Demon Slayer; Hashira; Wind Hashira
summary: Sanemi Shinazugawa is a Demon Slayer of the Demon Slayer Corps and the current Wind Hashira. He is the older brother of Genya Shinazugawa and one of the strongest swordsmen in the Corps. Sanemi is an exceptionally aggressive and skilled fighter who developed tremendous physical strength, speed, endurance, and swordsmanship through his experience as a Demon Slayer.

stats.liftingStrength: At least Class 25, at most Class 50
stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

notes: This represents Sanemi after completing the Hashira Training but without the Demon Slayer Mark. He was able to match Obanai, Muichiro, and Giyu during sparring and demonstrated exceptional skill against Kokushibo. His Marechi blood possesses an intoxicating effect on demons. Optional equipment includes Yushiro's talisman and oil and matches.
